about:
I am a **Computer Science Engineering student** at Alliance College of Engineering and Design, Alliance University (CGPA: **8.8**), graduating in July 2027.

My interests span **artificial intelligence**, **machine learning**, **Generative AI**, **Python development**, **backend systems**, **web development**, and **cybersecurity**. I enjoy exploring emerging technologies, building practical applications, and solving technical problems through software.

I have worked on AI-powered financial reconciliation platforms, semantic similarity-based resume screening systems, phishing detection with deep learning, and Android malware analysis. These projects have given me hands-on experience designing backend APIs, working with machine learning models, integrating LLMs, and building end-to-end software systems.

I am continuously improving my engineering skills, deepening my understanding of large language models and retrieval-augmented generation, and looking for opportunities to apply what I build to real problems.
